title: RONIN — inventario de 32 dominios y 64 bibliotecas General/HKD

policy.disjointness: global exact SHA-256 and global near-duplicate cluster; General and HKD must not share documents or duplicate clusters
policy.split_policy: train/validation/test are deterministic and disjoint; validation/test/holdout are never training data
policy.note: Legacy scoped-equivalent corpora and source-scoped train manifests are not strict Level A under this inventory. They remain visible as scoped material but do not count toward the 64-library minimum. Candidate metadata and provider/catalog declarations alone never count as text.
policy.admission_standard_description: Strict Level A requires evidence for the exact item and version; a canonical license compatible with the intended use or demonstrated public domain for the exact work/edition; ES, EU and US coverage; identified rights holder/provider and assertion scope; attribution; provenance; a per-item metadata snapshot SHA-256; payload SHA-256; and third-party clearance. Quality, privacy, exact and near-duplicate checks, General/HKD disjointness and split integrity are separate mandatory gates. Legacy/source-scoped admission is reported separately and never counts toward the 1 MiB strict Level A minimum.
policy.training_eligibility_note: G-0 is independent. While global G-0 is FAIL, all 64 libraries remain training_eligible=false even if strict Level A rights and quality gates later pass.

rights_registry_snapshot.note: Nine rights-Level-A records comprise six metadata-only exports and three exact CoVoST 2 payload/version records; metadata records are not training text. Two BOE public-domain-basis records remain Level B. No strict Level-A text has yet been admitted into the 64 libraries.

legacy_scoped_corpus.reason: Preserved under its earlier source-scoped manifest; not counted toward strict Level-A v2 without per-work/edition rights evidence, per-item metadata snapshot SHA-256 and explicit ES/EU/US clearance.

review_status_summary.owner_attested_human_review_coverage: all datasets and document collections mapped as of 2026-11-05
review_status_summary.technical_admission: Strict Level-A v2 admission is blocked until item/version rights evidence, metadata snapshots, jurisdiction coverage, quality/privacy, exact and near-duplicate checks, General/HKD disjointness and split integrity are verified. Existing scoped corpora remain separately reported.
review_status_summary.file_level_review: 8 NASA text files manually inspected: 4 content-legibility passes remain candidate-only; 3 held for severe OCR repair; 1 held because individual rights metadata is unresolved and OCR is poor. Three ScienceVerse metadata/routing anomalies remain documented and held. No NASA documents admitted; global deduplication, redistribution recheck and split isolation remain pending.
review_status_summary.owner_authored_papers: Nine owner-authorized Markdown papers from orbitalronin94/Papers are copied byte-for-byte into a scoped admitted corpus; README.md excluded. They are not yet counted toward Level A library minimums or eligible for training pending global deduplication, quality/privacy and partition gates.
review_status_summary.nasa_file_reviewed_corpus: Six individually file-reviewed NASA NTRS documents copied byte-for-byte into a scoped corpus. Four reviewed holds remain excluded. The remaining 814 NASA candidate texts are not individually reviewed. No Level-A counter or training eligibility change.
review_status_summary.scoped_nasa_admission: 813/824 NASA NTRS records admitted to a scoped corpus; 11 held; all training-ineligible pending global G-0.
review_status_summary.scienceverse_candidate_audit: All 7,403 exported ScienceVerse documents machine-audited for full-text quality and basic PII patterns: 7,337 quality passes, 66 holds, 15 missing author metadata. None admitted pending rights/third-party reconciliation and global dedup.
review_status_summary.scoped_scienceverse_admission: 7,365/7,403 documents remain source-scoped; the verified train audit is 7,103 documents / 426,975,945 UTF-8 bytes with 262 held for replacement-character excess. This source-scoped train partition is not strict Level A v2 and is not globally training-eligible; near-duplicate, benchmark/holdout and General/HKD gates remain pending.
review_status_summary.reclassification_note: The previous inventory counted legacy/source-scoped corpora toward Level-A library minima. Under the explicitly requested strict item/version standard, those counts are retained separately and strict Level-A library counters are reset to zero until evidence is complete.

scoped_file_reviewed_corpora.note: Four additional individually reviewed NASA files promoted after Git blob SHA-1/byte identity, candidate-pack match, public-use metadata, PII scan and exact cross-source dedup. Two other reviewed files were already train exact duplicates.

scoped_candidate_admissions.note: 813 admitted as scoped records after item-level NASA rights allowlist, exact source hashes, full-text quality screening and individual holds; HTML/Tika wrappers normalized. 4 manual holds and 7 quality holds remain. Weekly redistribution recheck and cross-source exact/near dedup, final partition gates still pending.

7,103 source-scoped train documents / 426,975,945 UTF-8 bytes were verified in run 42110130695; 262 held for excessive replacement characters. This is not strict Level A v2 and contributes zero to the 64-library strict Level-A counters. Global near-duplicate, benchmark/holdout and General/HKD checks remain pending.
